Art Cullagh is a Flaming Fist at Last Light Inn X: -67 Y: 167 abed, unresponsive, and singing about  Thaniel during Act Two.
“
Know that my heart is full and happy, and I am grateful for my last moments. Do visit some day. And if you have time to stop by an old Flaming Fist's grave, I know I'd love to see you.
„
— Art Cullagh bids farewell

Involvement

Act Two

Main articles: Lift the Shadow Curse and Wake Art Cullagh

Over 100 years ago, Grand Duke Eltan assigned Art Cullagh with the mission to investigate the Thorm family and Reithwin's House of Healing to determine whether a Sharran cult was being established in the town. However, once  Ketheric Thorm unleashed the Shadow Curse, Art became trapped in the Shadowfell for an extended period of time, causing his mental condition to deteriorate. Prior to the party's arrival, Art wandered out of the Shadowfell and was cared for by the Harpers and Flaming Fists at the Last Light Inn. If the party rescued  Florrick from the burning building in Waukeen's Rest,  Fist J'ehlar is tending to Art's wounds.

The party can attempt to speak with Art as he lies unconscious and sings about  Thaniel. He remains unresponsive but bringing this information to  Halsin progresses ⁠Lift the Shadow Curse and initiates ⁠Wake Art Cullagh. Halsin determines that the party must retrieve Art's  Battered Lute from the House of Healing and play its music to wake him up.

If the Battered Lute is recovered from  Malus Thorm and played for Art, he wakes and desperately asks for Halsin's help. Art explains that he met Thaniel in the Shadowfell and while he cannot pinpoint Thaniel's location, he recalls that it always "smelled of lavender" around him. This information allows the party to lift the Shadow Curse and grants the ⁠Strings of Fate to party members with the  Entertainer background.

Alternatively, Art may die during ⁠Resolve the Abduction if  Isobel is kidnapped or killed. Similarly, if Art is left unconscious before freeing the  Nightsong and initiating the raid on Moonrise Towers, he will be left for dead and alone in the Last Light Inn. However, the party can still cast  Speak with Dead to ask him about Thaniel, which skips Wake Art Cullagh and allows the party to lift the Shadow Curse anyway.

After the party complete ⁠Defeat Ketheric Thorm, Art can be found in Ketheric's throne room alongside several other characters. He thanks the party profusely if they successfully removed the Shadow Curse, but laments that his health is now rapidly deteriorating since it was sustained by the Shadowfell.

During the epilogue, the party can receive  Letter from Art if the Shadow Curse was lifted.

Speak with Dead

Art's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Art Cullagh
      Art... Cullagh of... the Flaming Fist.
  • What are you doing here?
    • Art Cullagh
      Investigating... Ketheric Thorm. Rumors of... Sharran cult. Worse... than we thought.
      • What can you tell me about Ketheric Thorm?
        • Art Cullagh
          He is... brutal. Cares for nothing... except... his daughter...
  • What happened to you?
    • Art Cullagh
      Curse... darkness... pain. Thaniel... have to help... Thaniel..
      • Thaniel? Who is that?
        • Art Cullagh
          Spirit... of the Land. In the... Shadowfell. Look for... lavender. He needs... he needs...
          • What does Thaniel need?
            • Art Cullagh
              Halsin.
      • I'm looking for Thaniel. Where is he?
        • Art Cullagh
          Shadowfell... shifts... and changes. But where Thaniel is... always smells... of lavender...
